In this notebook, I will make calculations for TCR clonal overlap analyses

```{r setup}
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)
library(divo)

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
colIBD <- "#EB6D33"

diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

diagSub.comp <- list(c("FGID", "cCD"), c("cCD", "UC"), c("FGID", "UC"))
```

```{r}
obs <- readRDS("out/annotations/scvi/251017__predictCOL_CB_allcells_obs.rds")
obs
```

```{r}
tcrs <- read_csv("data/tcr/filtered_contigs_paired_241120.csv")
tcrs
```

```{r}
seuobj.tnkilc <- readRDS("data/objects/annotated/predictCOL__CB_tnkilc_annotated_251017_v4.rds")
seuobj.tnkilc
```

```{r}
seuobj.tnkilc <- AddMetaData(seuobj.tnkilc, tcrs %>% column_to_rownames("barcode"))
seuobj.tnkilc@meta.data
```

# Prepare TCR Data

```{r}
tcrs.joined <- tcrs %>% 
  filter(barcode %in% rownames(obs)) %>% 
  left_join(., obs %>% 
              select(biopsy, diagSub, antitnf_response, participant_id, timepoint, cellstate, cellsubtype, celltype, tgroup) %>% 
              rownames_to_column("barcode"),
                  by = "barcode") %>% 
  relocate(barcode, biopsy, diagSub, antitnf_response, participant_id, timepoint, cellstate, cellsubtype, celltype, tgroup)

tcrs.joined
```

```{r}
tcrs.joined$celltype %>% table
tcrs.joined$celltype %>% table %>% prop.table*100
```

About 99% of TCRs are in TNKILC group

```{r}
tcrs.formatted <- tcrs.joined %>% 
  filter(celltype == "TNKILC") %>% 
  mutate(length.TRA = nchar(cdr3.TRA)) %>% 
  mutate(length.TRB = nchar(cdr3.TRB)) %>% 
  group_by(biopsy, cdr3.TRA) %>% 
  mutate(count.TRA = n()) %>% 
  mutate(count.TRA = ifelse(is.na(cdr3.TRA), NA, count.TRA)) %>% 
  group_by(biopsy, cdr3.TRB) %>% 
  mutate(count.TRB = n()) %>% 
  mutate(count.TRB = ifelse(is.na(cdr3.TRB), NA, count.TRB)) %>% 
  mutate(cdr3.Paired = paste(cdr3.TRA, cdr3.TRB, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(cdr3.Paired = ifelse(cdr3.Paired == "NA_NA", NA, cdr3.Paired)) %>% 
  group_by(biopsy, cdr3.Paired) %>% 
  mutate(count.Paired = n()) %>% 
  mutate(count.Paired = ifelse(is.na(cdr3.TRA) | is.na(cdr3.TRB), NA, count.Paired)) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  arrange(biopsy, cellstate) %>% 
  mutate(cdr3mr = ifelse(length.TRB >= 12 & length.TRB <= 17, substr(cdr3.TRB, 5, nchar(cdr3.TRB) - 6), NA)) %>% 
  select(barcode, biopsy, diagSub, antitnf_response, participant_id, timepoint, cellstate, cellsubtype, tgroup, cdr3mr,
         ends_with("Paired"), ends_with("TRA"), ends_with("TRB")) %>% 
  rename(
    cellstate = cellstate,
    cellsubtype = cellsubtype,
    TNKILC_Group = tgroup,
  )

tcrs.formatted
```

## Cell State Overlap

```{r}
shared.cdr3s.th1 <- tcrs.joined %>% 
  filter(diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC")) %>% 
  filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% 
  filter(cellstate %in% c("Th1", "Prlf. Teff")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(cdr3.TRA) & !is.na(cdr3.TRB)) %>% 
  mutate(cdr3 = paste(cdr3.TRA, cdr3.TRB, sep = "_")) %>% 
  group_by(cdr3, biopsy) %>% 
  distinct(cdr3, biopsy, cellstate, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  mutate(cdr3.shared = ifelse(n() > 1, TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
  distinct(cdr3, biopsy, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  filter(cdr3.shared) %>% 
  pull(cdr3)

shared.cdr3s.th1
```



```{r}
shared.cdr3s.th17 <- tcrs.joined %>% 
  filter(diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC")) %>% 
  filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% 
  filter(cellstate %in% c("Th17", "Prlf. Teff")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(cdr3.TRA) & !is.na(cdr3.TRB)) %>% 
  mutate(cdr3 = paste(cdr3.TRA, cdr3.TRB, sep = "_")) %>% 
  group_by(cdr3, biopsy) %>% 
  distinct(cdr3, biopsy, cellstate, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  mutate(cdr3.shared = ifelse(n() > 1, TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
  distinct(cdr3, biopsy, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  filter(cdr3.shared) %>% 
  pull(cdr3)

shared.cdr3s.th17
```

```{r}
shared.prlf.th.df <- tcrs.formatted %>% 
  filter(timepoint == "T0" & diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC") & !is.na(cdr3.TRA) & !is.na(cdr3.TRB) & cellstate == "Prlf. Teff") %>% 
  select(barcode, biopsy, diagSub, antitnf_response, cellstate, cdr3.Paired) %>% 
  mutate(Th1_Overlap = ifelse(cdr3.Paired %in% shared.cdr3s.th1, TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
  mutate(Th17_Overlap = ifelse(cdr3.Paired %in% shared.cdr3s.th17, TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
  arrange(diagSub, biopsy)

shared.prlf.th.df
```

```{r}
write_csv(shared.prlf.th.df, "out/tcr/clonaloverlap/ccduc_th1th17prlfteff_shared.csv")
```

```{r}
shared.th1.network <- tcrs.joined %>% 
  filter(diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC")) %>% 
  filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% 
  filter(cellstate %in% c("Th1", "Prlf. Teff")) %>% 
  mutate(cdr3 = paste(cdr3.TRA, cdr3.TRB, sep = "_")) %>% 
  filter(cdr3 %in% shared.cdr3s.th1) %>% 
  add_count(cdr3, cellstate, name = "n") %>% 
  select(barcode, biopsy, diagSub, cdr3, cellstate, n) %>% 
  distinct(biopsy, barcode, cellstate, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  arrange(diagSub, biopsy, cdr3, cellstate) %>% 
  rename(cdr3.Paired = cdr3, CellState = cellstate, count = n) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = CellState, values_from = c(count, barcode),
              values_fn = list(
                "count" = unique
              )) %>% 
  rowwise %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = starts_with("barcode"),
      .fns = ~paste(., collapse = "___")
    )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup

shared.th1.network
```

```{r}
shared.th17.network <- tcrs.joined %>% 
  filter(diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC")) %>% 
  filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% 
  filter(cellstate %in% c("Th17", "Prlf. Teff")) %>% 
  mutate(cdr3 = paste(cdr3.TRA, cdr3.TRB, sep = "_")) %>% 
  filter(cdr3 %in% shared.cdr3s.th17) %>% 
  add_count(cdr3, cellstate, name = "n") %>% 
  select(barcode, biopsy, diagSub, cdr3, cellstate, n) %>% 
  distinct(biopsy, barcode, cellstate, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  arrange(diagSub, biopsy, cdr3, cellstate) %>% 
  rename(cdr3.Paired = cdr3, CellState = cellstate, count = n) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = CellState, values_from = c(count, barcode),
              values_fn = list(
                "count" = unique
              )) %>% 
  rowwise %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = starts_with("barcode"),
      .fns = ~paste(., collapse = "___")
    )
  ) %>% 
  ungroup

shared.th17.network
```

```{r}
write_csv(shared.th1.network, "out/tcr/clonaloverlap/ccduc_th1prlfteff_network.csv")
write_csv(shared.th17.network, "out/tcr/clonaloverlap/ccduc_th17prlfteff_network.csv")
```

# CD8+ Th17

```{r}
th17.barcodes <- seuobj.tnkilc@meta.data %>% 
  filter(!is.na(cdr3.TRA) & !is.na(cdr3.TRB) & timepoint == "T0" & diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC") & cellstate == "Th17") %>% 
  rownames

th17.barcodes %>% length
```

```{r}
seuobj.th17 <- subset(seuobj.tnkilc, cells = th17.barcodes)
seuobj.th17
```

```{r}
exp.cd8a <- FetchData(seuobj.th17, "CD8A") %>% 
  rownames_to_column("barcode")
exp.cd8a
```

```{r}
cd8.th17.df <- tcrs.formatted %>% 
  filter(timepoint == "T0" & diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC") & !is.na(cdr3.TRA) & !is.na(cdr3.TRB) & cellstate == "Th17") %>% 
  select(barcode, biopsy, diagSub, antitnf_response, cellstate, cdr3.Paired) %>% 
  mutate(`Prlf. Teff_Overlap` = ifelse(cdr3.Paired %in% shared.cdr3s.th17, TRUE, FALSE)) %>% 
  left_join(exp.cd8a, by = "barcode") %>% 
  rename(CD8A_LogExp = CD8A) %>% 
  mutate(CD8A = ifelse(CD8A_LogExp > 0, "CD8A+", "CD8A-")) %>% 
  mutate(CD8A = fct_relevel(CD8A, c("CD8A-", "CD8A+"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(`Prlf. Teff_Overlap`), diagSub, desc(CD8A_LogExp), biopsy)

cd8.th17.df
```

```{r}
write_csv(cd8.th17.df, "out/tcr/clonaloverlap/ccduc_cd8th17_prlfteffoverlap.csv")
```

```{r}
tcrs.formatted.cd8 <- tcrs.formatted %>% 
  left_join(exp.cd8a, by = "barcode") %>% 
  rename(CD8A_LogExp = CD8A) %>% 
  mutate(CD8A = ifelse(CD8A_LogExp > 0, "CD8A+", "CD8A-")) %>% 
  mutate(CD8A = fct_relevel(CD8A, c("CD8A-", "CD8A+"))) %>% 
  relocate(CD8A_LogExp, CD8A, .after = cellstate) %>% 
  mutate(cellsubstate = case_when(
    cellstate == "Th1" ~ "Th1",
    cellstate == "Prlf. Teff" ~ "Prlf. Teff",
    cellstate == "Th17" & CD8A == "CD8A-" ~ "CD8A- Th17",
    cellstate == "Th17" & CD8A == "CD8A+" ~ "CD8A+ Th17"
  ), .after = cellstate)
```

```{r}
tcrs.formatted.cd8 %>% 
  filter(!is.na(cellsubstate)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(cdr3.TRA) & !is.na(cdr3.TRB)) %>% 
  filter(timepoint == "T0" & diagSub == "cCD") %>% 
  group_by(cdr3.Paired, cellsubstate) %>% 
  dplyr::count() %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "cdr3.Paired", names_from = cellsubstate, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("cdr3.Paired") %>% 
  mh(PlugIn = T) %>% 
  .$PlugIn -> ccd.morisita.cd8

ccd.morisita.cd8
```

```{r}
ccd.rows <- rownames(ccd.morisita.cd8)
ccd.cols <- colnames(ccd.morisita.cd8)
ccd.morisita.cd8.df <- data.frame(cellsubstate1 = character(), cellsubstate2 = character(), morisita = numeric())
for (i in 1:nrow(ccd.morisita.cd8)){
  for (j in 1:ncol(ccd.morisita.cd8)){
    if (i > j) {
      ccd.morisita.cd8.df <- rbind(
        ccd.morisita.cd8.df,
        data.frame(cellsubstate1 = ccd.rows[i], cellsubstate2 = ccd.cols[j], morisita = ccd.morisita.cd8[i,j])
      )
    }
  }
} 

ccd.morisita.cd8.df <- rbind(
  ccd.morisita.cd8.df,
  data.frame(cellsubstate1 = ccd.morisita.cd8.df$cellsubstate2, cellsubstate2 = ccd.morisita.cd8.df$cellsubstate1, morisita = ccd.morisita.cd8.df$morisita)
) %>%  
  mutate(cellsubstate1 = fct_relevel(cellsubstate1, levels(tcrs.formatted$cellstate))) %>% 
  mutate(cellsubstate2 = fct_relevel(cellsubstate2, levels(tcrs.formatted$cellstate))) %>% 
  arrange(-morisita)

ccd.morisita.cd8.df
```

```{r}
tcrs.formatted.cd8 %>% 
  filter(!is.na(cellsubstate)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(cdr3.TRA) & !is.na(cdr3.TRB)) %>% 
  filter(timepoint == "T0" & diagSub == "UC") %>% 
  group_by(cdr3.Paired, cellsubstate) %>% 
  dplyr::count() %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "cdr3.Paired", names_from = cellsubstate, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("cdr3.Paired") %>% 
  mh(PlugIn = T) %>% 
  .$PlugIn -> uc.morisita.cd8

uc.morisita.cd8
```

```{r}
uc.rows <- rownames(uc.morisita.cd8)
uc.cols <- colnames(uc.morisita.cd8)
uc.morisita.cd8.df <- data.frame(cellsubstate1 = character(), cellsubstate2 = character(), morisita = numeric())
for (i in 1:nrow(uc.morisita.cd8)){
  for (j in 1:ncol(uc.morisita.cd8)){
    if (i > j) {
      uc.morisita.cd8.df <- rbind(
        uc.morisita.cd8.df,
        data.frame(cellsubstate1 = uc.rows[i], cellsubstate2 = uc.cols[j], morisita = uc.morisita.cd8[i,j])
      )
    }
  }
} 

uc.morisita.cd8.df <- rbind(
  uc.morisita.cd8.df,
  data.frame(cellsubstate1 = uc.morisita.cd8.df$cellsubstate2, cellsubstate2 = uc.morisita.cd8.df$cellsubstate1, morisita = uc.morisita.cd8.df$morisita)
) %>%  
  mutate(cellsubstate1 = fct_relevel(cellsubstate1, levels(tcrs.formatted$cellstate))) %>%

  arrange(-morisita)

uc.morisita.cd8.df
```


```{r}
ccduc.morisita.cd8.df <- rbind(
  ccd.morisita.cd8.df %>% mutate(diagSub = "cCD"),
  uc.morisita.cd8.df %>% mutate(diagSub = "UC")
)

ccduc.morisita.cd8.df
```

```{r}
separator <- "—"

plot.pairs <- c(
  paste("Th1", "Prlf. Teff", sep = separator),
  paste("CD8A- Th17", "Prlf. Teff", sep = separator),
  paste("CD8A+ Th17", "Prlf. Teff", sep = separator)
)

ccduc.morisita.cd8.df.out <- ccduc.morisita.cd8.df %>% 
  mutate(cellsubtype_paired = paste(cellsubstate1, cellsubstate2, sep = separator), .after = cellsubstate2) %>% 
  filter(cellsubtype_paired %in% plot.pairs) %>% 
  arrange(cellsubstate1)

ccduc.morisita.cd8.df.out
```

```{r}
write_csv(ccduc.morisita.cd8.df.out, "out/tcr/clonaloverlap/ccduc_cd8th17_morisita.csv")
```
